title: Community book drive
purpose: Collect gently used books for the community library
action: Drop off books at the community center
source_message: Our community book drive is open until December 12. Please drop off gently used books at the community center front desk between 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Monday through Friday. We cannot accept textbooks or damaged books. If you have more than 20 books, please call +1-555-0142 first so we can arrange pickup. Thank you for sharing your books with your neighbors.
plain_language_notes: 'Gently used' is friendly but may not be understood - 'books your family has finished with' is clearer.
The 20-book condition is a real condition and must not be dropped in translation.
